name: GenOffice
use_label: AI office suite, MS Office alternative
one_liner: Free desktop office suite for real .docx/.xlsx/.pptx and PDF, with an AI on your own key.

text.why: Office alternatives are plenty, but 'open, save, formatting breaks' is the usual failure; GenOffice avoids it by rewriting only the blocks you edited and copying everything else byte-for-byte. An AI panel sits beside every document: edits arrive as tracked changes in Docs and as live formulas (SUMIF, for example) in Sheets, and each AI turn is a snapshot you can roll back. PDF to Word/Excel/PowerPoint conversion and OCR of scans (macOS and Windows) run on-device, and the model is either a Genspark sign-in or your own key for Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek and others, local servers included.
text.take: More important than the 'AI office' label are the byte-preserving save and the command line; together they give coding agents a way to produce real Office files instead of Markdown approximations.
build: With the bundled `genoffice` command line and agent skill, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and others can create and check real .docx/.xlsx/.pptx files without opening a window — monthly reports, quotes, slide drafts. The HTML app proposes a design brief first, then builds a single-file landing page you can export to Word or PDF.

who.role: Individuals and small teams handling .docx/.xlsx/.pptx without Microsoft Office
who.situation: open, edit and save with the original formatting intact

who.role: People who want AI to do document work but review it
who.situation: tracked changes, diffs, rollback, answers with cell citations

who.role: Developers automating documents with coding agents
who.situation: create, convert and check files headless via the `genoffice` CLI and skill

start.text: 1. Download from https://github.com/genspark-ai/genoffice/releases/latest — macOS 11+ (.dmg, arm64/x64), Windows 10+ x64 · Windows 11 on Arm ARM64 (.exe), Linux glibc 2.34+ (.deb/.rpm/.AppImage)
4. Skill for coding agents: npx skills add genspark-ai/genoffice

caveat: Apache-2.0 licence (the ee/ directory is under a separate enterprise licence; the GenOffice and Genspark names and logos are Mainfunc trademarks, not covered). The apps are free with no paid tier, but AI features need a network connection and either a Genspark sign-in (the homepage says Genspark credits) or your own API key; model costs are yours.
macOS 11+, Windows 10+ x64 · Windows 11 on Arm ARM64, Linux x86_64 with glibc 2.34+; macOS and Windows installers are signed.
Official packaged builds send limited usage analytics by default (never document content, file names or paths); disable under Settings → General. 'In active development' per the README.

license.scope_text: Commercial use, redistribution OK. Keep notices; mark changes.
